name: Doubt ~Anata wa Dark na Uso ga Suki?~
original_name: ダウト～貴女はダークな嘘が好き？ ～
source: You grew up as the daughter of a mob leader, but you dream of an ordinary life. However, your father pretends to set you up an engagement so you'll become the next chairman! How  will you fight the villains in your life to reach your happy ending?
translation: 你作为暴徒首领的女儿长大，却梦想过上普通生活。然而，你的父亲假装要为你安排婚约，实际是想让你成为下一任会长！你要如何对抗生活中的恶人，走向幸福结局？
